description: No module the MCP server can reach writes to the process's stdout except bin/lib/output-sink.ts. The walk follows static and dynamic relative imports from mcp/**; stdout is the server's JSON-RPC channel, and its pensmith_* tools run the CLI verbs in-process (a `pensmith plan: wrote …` line there made Claude Code drop the server, T1-15). It checks each reachable module's text for process.stdout.write, the process.stdout stream handed around as a value, and console.log/info/debug/dir/table calls, wherever the module lives — also outside the stdout-sink lint row's scope and allow list (a statically imported pdf-worker.ts would print on the main thread; pdf-text.ts's type-only import of it is erased at runtime and not followed). Print through out(); the server points that sink at stderr.
